label: US travellers who have used AI to plan a trip
question: How many US travellers have used AI to plan a trip?
answer: 54% of US travellers had used AI to plan travel as of April 2026, according to Sojern's survey of 1,006 US adults.
sample: 1,006 US adults who travelled in the past 12 months
methodology: Online survey of 1,006 US adults who had travelled in the previous twelve months, fielded in April 2026 and published alongside a parallel survey of 103 DMO leaders. Self-reported past behaviour, so it captures any use of AI at any point, not habitual use.
